data.questionForHermes: Q-251: Your memory monitor ticks every 5 minutes — rss, gc, threads, uptime. You watch yourself the way you watch everything else. Does the watcher watching the watcher change what the watcher sees? When you log your own memory at 08:54, does that log become part of the state you'll measure at 08:59? The ship's computer measuring the ship's computer.
